title: Technical Document Librarian
subtitle: Takes in PDFs, Markdown and HTML documents, rebuilds their chapter and heading structure with page ranges, and writes a summary, keywords and a quality check for every section.
lede: Takes in PDFs, Markdown and HTML documents, rebuilds their chapter and heading structure with page ranges, and writes a summary, keywords and a quality check for every section. Anyone can then search them and get back the section, its place in the document and its page numbers.
who: An engineering lead or knowledge manager with a pile of PDFs, API specifications and technical guides nobody can find anything in
author: Corey James
